name: Hermite Data Computation via Bisection
definition: A method to find all edge crossings in an adaptive octree for an implicit function and compute Hermite data (intersection points and normals) using bisection.
summary: Hermite Data Computation via Bisection precisely locates isosurface intersections on octree edges using iterative bisection to achieve sub-cell accuracy, unlike linear interpolation methods that cause jaggedness.
